product_overview: The CFDI Automation System is a comprehensive platform designed to automate Mexican CFDI 4.0 invoice processing using advanced OCR technology, browser automation, and modern web interfaces. It features user authentication, task management, real-time browser automation, and multi-vendor receipt processing with high accuracy and cost optimization.
core_goals: Enable seamless user authentication and profile management with detailed CFDI fields.
Provide robust task management for creating, executing, and monitoring browser automation tasks.
Integrate advanced OCR processing for multiple vendors with high accuracy and vendor-specific extraction.
Support real-time monitoring and control of browser automation tasks via WebSocket.
Ensure scalable, secure, and containerized deployment for production environments.
Implement comprehensive testing and validation to guarantee system stability.
key_features: User authentication system with registration, login, profile management, and JWT token support.
Dashboard interface with task creation, monitoring, and statistics display.
CFDI task submission supporting natural language prompts and browser automation.
Browser-use integration for local browser automation with real-time status and logs.
Enhanced OCR processing supporting Azure Document Intelligence and LangExtract hybrid architecture for flexible, high-accuracy field extraction.
RESTful API with comprehensive endpoints for authentication, task and ticket management, browser automation control, and health checks.
Real-time WebSocket communication for live task updates and browser agent control.
Vendor-specific OCR templates and detailed performance tracking for major Mexican retailers.
Docker-based multi-service deployment including frontend, backend, Python browser service, Nginx reverse proxy, and Redis caching.
Secure environment and configuration management with support for multiple AI providers.
Comprehensive testing framework covering unit, integration, API, and end-to-end tests with hydration and frontend stability fixes.
user_flow_summary: User registers or logs in via the authentication pages, providing detailed CFDI profile information.
Authenticated users create browser automation tasks via the dashboard or upload tickets for processing.
The system processes uploaded tickets using OCR engines (Azure, LangExtract) to extract CFDI fields with vendor detection.
Users can monitor task and ticket processing status in real-time through the dashboard with WebSocket updates.
Upon successful OCR extraction, users can create automated browser agent tasks to submit invoices to vendor portals.
Users have interactive control over browser agent tasks with pause, resume, and takeover capabilities.
The backend manages task queues, executes tasks using browser-use library integrated with Python bridge, and serves comprehensive health information.
The system ensures all operations are logged, validated, and auditable with proper error handling and rate limiting.
validation_criteria: All API endpoints conform to the documented contracts with correct request and response formats.
User authentication correctly enforces JWT authorization and supports full profile CRUD operations.
Task lifecycle actions including create, execute, pause, resume, and cancel operate reliably with accurate status reporting.
OCR processing returns high-confidence structured data conforming to vendor-specific extraction schemas.
Browser-use automation tasks execute successfully with real-time monitoring and logging.
Frontend components render without hydration mismatches or reconciliation errors and support responsive design.
Docker containers build and run all services as expected with health endpoints passing.
Automated tests achieve high coverage and pass consistently across unit, integration, and API layers.
System logs errors clearly and handles failure scenarios gracefully without data loss.
